body: [{"streamId":"01a0c3e2-d369-7598-8abf-74a988f1b5b6","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0c3e2-d369-7598-8abf-74a988f1b5b6\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022The message sweep reads a project\\u0027s remote once per tick: a single ls-remote over the refs/hall9k namespace feeds the trust chain, the message probe, and the prompt-addenda sweep, and the trust chain is recomputed only when a ledger ref\\u0027s tip moved since the last computation\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022One sweep tick makes exactly one git ls-remote per project when nothing on the remote has moved, down from six calls (owner roots listing, owner chain fetch, node ids listing, nodes fetch, members fetch, message probe); a unit test over the recorded command sequence proves the count for the unmoved case and for each kind of moved ref\u0022,\u0022The trust chain is cached per project keyed by the set of ledger ref tips the listing returned; an unmoved set reuses the cached chain without any fetch, a moved tip under any ledger prefix fetches only that prefix and recomputes, and a failed listing keeps the previous chain out of use exactly as today\\u0027s failed computation does (fail closed, sweep skipped this tick)\u0022,\u0022The message probe and the prompt-addenda sweep take their tips from the same listing rather than issuing their own ls-remote; the existing unmoved-tip skip in the message probe keeps its behaviour and its tests\u0022,\u0022The daemon log records, at debug, the per-tick call count per project so the reduction can be read off a running node; the h9kd.log line count of GitHub calls per hour at idle on a node with four projects falls from about 2,300 to under 300 with the default cadence\u0022,\u0022No change to the active or idle cadence defaults, to the transport\\u0027s wire format, to the ledger layout, or to what is trusted; the trust chain reader\\u0027s fail-closed refusal on a partial read is preserved and tested\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Refactor\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Origin: the 2026-09-21 network investigation in the hall9k project home (notes/network-drops.log, the 08:10 DIAGNOSIS entry). Measured on the Mac at idle: 59 git/gh network processes per 90 s, about 2,360 GitHub HTTPS connections per hour, five of six per project per sweep being GitLedgerChainReader.ComputeAsync recomputing from scratch (its own doc says recomputed fresh). MessageSweepEngine already skips reading messages on an unmoved tip (one ls-remote deciding); this task extends that pattern to the whole sweep. Files: src/Hall9k.Connectors/Trust/GitLedgerChainReader.cs, src/Hall9k.Daemon/Messaging/MessageSweepEngine.cs, src/Hall9k.Daemon/PromptAddenda/PromptAddendaSweepEngine.cs. Brian\\u0027s interim ruling of 2026-09-21 raised the idle cadence to 120 to 180 s on both nodes as a stopgap; revert that when this ships.
